def apply_layered_mods(self, mods_root: Path) -> List[Tuple[str, int]]:
        """Scans mods_root for mod directories with mod.toml and applies overrides
        in order of priority (higher priority overwrites lower)."""
        if not mods_root.is_dir():
            return []

        discovered_mods: List[Tuple[ModMetadata, Path]] = []
        seen_ids = set()
        for entry in sorted(mods_root.iterdir()):
            if entry.is_symlink() or not entry.is_dir():
                continue
            romfs_dir = entry / "romfs"
            if romfs_dir.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError(f"Mod romfs must not be a symlink: {romfs_dir}")
            if not romfs_dir.is_dir():
                continue
            meta = self._parse_mod_toml(entry / "mod.toml", entry.name)
            if not meta.id or any(c not in "REDACTED" for c in meta.id):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid mod ID: {meta.id!r}")
            if meta.id in seen_ids:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate mod ID: {meta.id}")
            seen_ids.add(meta.id)
            discovered_mods.append((meta, romfs_dir))

        # Sort by priority ascending (so higher priority applies last / wins)
        discovered_mods.sort(key=lambda m: (m[0].priority, m[0].id))

        applied: List[Tuple[str, int]] = []
        for meta, romfs_dir in discovered_mods:
            override_count = 0
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(romfs_dir, followlinks=False):
                root_path = Path(root)
                for name in dirs + files:
                    if (root_path / name).is_symlink():
                        raise ValueError(f"Symlinks are not allowed in mod layers: {root_path / name}")
                for f in files:
                    full_p = root_path / f
                    rel_p = full_p.relative_to(romfs_dir).as_posix()
                    self._validate_virtual_path(rel_p)
                    if len(self.files) >= 65535 and rel_p not in self.files:
                        raise ValueError("NitroFS file count exceeds the 16-bit file ID limit")
                    self.files[rel_p] = full_p.read_bytes()
                    override_count += 1
            applied.append((meta.id, override_count))

        return applied

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_virtual_path(path: str) -> None:
        parts = path.split("/")
        if (not path or path.startswith("/") or "\\" in path or ":" in path
                or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts)):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid NitroFS path: {path!r}")
        for part in parts:
            try:
                encoded = part.encode("latin-1")
            except UnicodeEncodeError as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"NitroFS path is not representable in the FNT: {path!r}") from exc
            if len(encoded) > 127 or any(ord(ch) < 32 for ch in part):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid NitroFS path component: {part!r}")

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_mod_toml(toml_path: Path, default_id: str) -> ModMetadata:
        meta = ModMetadata(id=default_id)
        if not toml_path.exists():
            return meta
        for line in toml_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            k = k.strip().lower()
            v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
            if k == "id":
                meta.id = v
            elif k == "name":
                meta.name = v
            elif k == "author":
                meta.author = v
            elif k == "version":
                meta.version = v
            elif k == "priority":
                try:
                    meta.priority = int(v)
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        return meta

    def build_fnt_and_fat(self, base_file_offset: int = 0) -> Tuple[bytes, bytes, bytes]:
        """Rebuilds NitroFS FNT and FAT structures plus the contiguous file payload data."""
        # 1. Build directory tree from self.files keys
        # Tree node: { "files": [name...], "dirs": { name: node } }
        tree: dict = {"files": [], "dirs": {}}
        if len(self.files) > 65535:
            raise ValueError("NitroFS file count exceeds the 16-bit file ID limit")
        for file_path in sorted(self.files.keys()):
            self._validate_virtual_path(file_path)
            parts = file_path.split("/")
            cur = tree
            for folder in parts[:-1]:
                if folder in cur["files"]:
                    raise ValueError(f"NitroFS path is both a file and directory: {file_path!r}")
                if folder not in cur["dirs"]:
                    cur["dirs"][folder] = {"files": [], "dirs": {}}
                cur = cur["dirs"][folder]
            if parts[-1] in cur["dirs"]:
                raise ValueError(f"NitroFS path is both a file and directory: {file_path!r}")
            cur["files"].append(parts[-1])

        # Assign directory IDs (Breadth-first search)
        # Root is 0xF000
        dir_list: List[Tuple[str, dict, int]] = [("", tree, 0xF000)]  # (rel_path, node, parent_id)
        queue = [("", tree, 0xF000)]
        next_dir_id = 0xF001

        all_nodes: List[Tuple[int, dict, int]] = [(0xF000, tree, 0xF000)]  # (dir_id, node, parent_id)
        node_path_map: dict[int, str] = {id(tree): ""}
        while queue:
            parent_path, parent_node, parent_id = queue.pop(0)
            for dname in sorted(parent_node["dirs"].keys()):
                cur_node = parent_node["dirs"][dname]
                cur_id = next_dir_id
                next_dir_id += 1
                cur_path = f"{parent_path}/{dname}" if parent_path else dname
                node_path_map[id(cur_node)] = cur_path
                all_nodes.append((cur_id, cur_node, parent_id))
                queue.append((cur_path, cur_node, cur_id))

        total_dirs = len(all_nodes)
        if total_dirs > 4096:
            raise ValueError("NitroFS directory count exceeds the supported limit")
        dir_table_size = total_dirs * 8

        # 2. Build sub-tables and determine file IDs
        sub_tables: List[bytes] = []
        cur_sub_off = dir_table_size
        dir_entries_meta: List[Tuple[int, int, int]] = []  # (sub_off, first_fid, parent_id)

        ordered_files: List[str] = []
        cur_fid = 0

        # Build sub-table for each directory
        for dir_id, node, parent_id in all_nodes:
            first_fid = cur_fid
            buf = bytearray()
            dpath = node_path_map.get(id(node), "")

            # Files first
            for fname in sorted(node["files"]):
                enc_name = fname.encode("latin-1")
                buf.append(len(enc_name))
                buf.extend(enc_name)
                full_path = f"{dpath}/{fname}" if dpath else fname
                ordered_files.append(full_path)
                cur_fid += 1

            # Sub-directories
            for dname in sorted(node["dirs"].keys()):
                enc_dname = dname.encode("latin-1")
                buf.append(len(enc_dname) | 0x80)
                buf.extend(enc_dname)
                # Locate assigned sub_dir_id
                sub_id = next(nid for nid, n, _ in all_nodes if n is node["dirs"][dname])
                buf.extend(struct.pack("<H", sub_id))

            buf.append(0x00)  # End of directory marker
            dir_entries_meta.append((cur_sub_off, first_fid, parent_id if dir_id != 0xF000 else total_dirs))
            sub_tables.append(bytes(buf))
            cur_sub_off += len(buf)

        # Assemble full FNT bytes
        fnt_buf = bytearray()
        for sub_off, first_fid, parent_or_count in dir_entries_meta:
            fnt_buf.extend(struct.pack("<IHH", sub_off, first_fid, parent_or_count))
        for st in sub_tables:
            fnt_buf.extend(st)

        # Pad FNT to 4-byte alignment
        while len(fnt_buf) % 4 != 0:
            fnt_buf.append(0x00)

        # 3. Assemble FAT and payload data in the EXACT same order as FNT IDs
        payload_buf = bytearray()
        fat_buf = bytearray()
        cur_file_data_off = base_file_offset

        for file_path in ordered_files:
            data = self.files[file_path]
            start_off = cur_file_data_off
            end_off = start_off + len(data)
            fat_buf.extend(struct.pack("<II", start_off, end_off))
            payload_buf.extend(data)
            # Pad file to 4-byte alignment
            cur_file_data_off = end_off
            while len(payload_buf) % 4 != 0:
                payload_buf.append(0x00)
                cur_file_data_off += 1

        return bytes(fnt_buf), bytes(fat_buf), bytes(payload_buf)

def encode_rescue_mail(data: RescueMailData) -> str:
    bw = BitWriter()
    kind_code = {"SOS": 1, "A-OK": 2, "THANK-YOU": 3}.get(data.kind.upper(), 1)
    bw.write_bits(kind_code, 3)
    bw.write_bits(data.dungeon_id & 0x7F, 7)
    bw.write_bits(data.floor & 0x7F, 7)
    bw.write_bits(data.client_species & 0x7FF, 11)
    bw.write_bits(data.rescue_id & 0xFFFFFFFF, 32)
    bw.write_bits(data.revives_left & 0x7, 3)

    # Encode team name (up to 10 chars, 8 bits each = 80 bits)
    name_bytes = data.team_name.encode("latin-1", errors="replace")[:10]
    bw.write_bits(len(name_bytes), 4)
    for b in name_bytes:
        bw.write_bits(b, 8)

    raw_symbols = bw.to_5bit_symbols()
    # Pad to 52 symbols
    while len(raw_symbols) < 52:
        raw_symbols.append((len(raw_symbols) * 7) % 32)

    # 10-bit checksum -> 2 symbols
    chk = compute_checksum(raw_symbols[:52])
    raw_symbols.append((chk >> 5) & 0x1F)
    raw_symbols.append(chk & 0x1F)

    # Convert to 54 characters
    return "".join(WONDER_MAIL_CHARSET[s] for s in raw_symbols)


def decode_rescue_mail(password: str) -> RescueMailData:
    clean = re_clean_password(password)
    if len(clean) != 54:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid Rescue password length: expected 54 chars, got {len(clean)}")

    symbols = [CHAR_TO_VAL[c] for c in clean]
    expected_chk = (symbols[52] << 5) | symbols[53]
    actual_chk = compute_checksum(symbols[:52])
    if actual_chk != expected_chk:
        raise ValueError("Invalid Rescue Mail checksum")

    bits: list[int] = []
    for s in symbols[:52]:
        for i in range(4, -1, -1):
            bits.append((s >> i) & 1)

    br = BitReader(bits)
    kind_code = br.read_bits(3)
    kind_str = {1: "SOS", 2: "A-OK", 3: "THANK-YOU"}.get(kind_code, "SOS")
    dungeon_id = br.read_bits(7)
    floor = br.read_bits(7)
    client_species = br.read_bits(11)
    rescue_id = br.read_bits(32)
    revives_left = br.read_bits(3)

    name_len = br.read_bits(4)
    name_bytes = bytearray()
    for _ in range(name_len):
        name_bytes.append(br.read_bits(8))

    team_name = name_bytes.decode("latin-1", errors="replace")
    return RescueMailData(
        kind=kind_str,
        dungeon_id=dungeon_id,
        floor=floor,
        team_name=team_name,
        client_species=client_species,
        rescue_id=rescue_id,
        revives_left=revives_left,
    )


def re_clean_password(raw_str: str) -> str:
    """Strips whitespace, hyphens, and newlines from a password."""
    return "".join(c.upper() for c in raw_str if c in CHAR_TO_VAL)

1: # SkyRecompiled Online Friend Rescue Service
2: 
3: An asynchronous online rescue board for *Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky*, designed to run at near-\$0 cost on **Cloudflare Workers** and **Cloudflare D1 (Serverless SQLite)**.
4: 
5: ## Features
6: - **100% Offline Compatible:** Players can copy and paste official 54-character SOS/A-OK passwords or use this REST API.
7: - **\$0/mo Free Tier Deployment:** Operates within Cloudflare's generous free tier:
8:   - 100,000 Worker requests/day
9:   - 5,000,000 D1 row reads/day
10:   - 100,000 D1 row writes/day
11: - **Rescue Claim Leases:** 24-hour claim leases automatically revert back to `open` if a rescuer abandons a mission.
12: - **CORS Enabled:** Seamlessly queried from the native `SkyRecompiled` launcher, a web portal, or Discord bots.

"""Unit tests for scripts/launcher.py settings persistence, reset, and ROM verification."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

import scripts.launcher as launcher


class TestLauncher(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_verify_sha1_missing_empty_and_progress(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            base = Path(td)
            missing = base / "missing.nds"
            self.assertFalse(launcher.verify_sha1(str(missing)))

            empty = base / "empty.nds"
            empty.write_bytes(b"")
            self.assertFalse(launcher.verify_sha1(str(empty)))

            sample = base / "Pokémon Mystery Dungeon (Spaces & Unicode é).nds"
            payload = b"SKY_RECOMPILED_TEST_ROM" * 1024
            sample.write_bytes(payload)
            sample_sha1 = hashlib.sha1(payload).hexdigest()

            self.assertFalse(launcher.verify_sha1(str(sample)))
            seen_progress: list[tuple[float, str]] = []
            with mock.patch.object(launcher, "VALID_ROM_SHA1S", {sample_sha1}):
                self.assertTrue(
                    launcher.verify_sha1(
                        str(sample),
                        progress_cb=lambda pct, msg: seen_progress.append((pct, msg)),
                    )
                )
            self.assertTrue(seen_progress)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(seen_progress[-1][0], 60.0)
            self.assertIn("100%", seen_progress[-1][1])

    def test_save_settings_preserves_unrelated_keys_and_unicode_paths(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            settings_file = Path(td) / "nested" / "settings.toml"
            settings_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            settings_file.write_text(
                '# Existing\nrescue_endpoint = "https://example.invalid"\nui_theme = "dark"\n',
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            rom_path = "/Users/Player One/ROMs/Pokémon Explorers of Sky (USA).nds"
            launcher.save_settings(settings_file, {"rom_path": rom_path})

            loaded = launcher.load_settings(settings_file)
            self.assertEqual(loaded["rom_path"], rom_path)
            self.assertEqual(loaded["rescue_endpoint"], "https://example.invalid")
            self.assertEqual(loaded["ui_theme"], "dark")
            self.assertEqual(list(settings_file.parent.iterdir()), [settings_file])

    def test_clear_saved_rom_path_preserves_other_settings(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            settings_file = Path(td) / "settings.toml"
            launcher.save_settings(
                settings_file,
                {"rom_path": "/tmp/sky.nds", "custom_flag": "enabled"},
                merge=False,
            )
            launcher.clear_saved_rom_path(settings_file)
            loaded = launcher.load_settings(settings_file)
            self.assertNotIn("rom_path", loaded)
            self.assertEqual(loaded["custom_flag"], "enabled")
            self.assertEqual(list(settings_file.parent.iterdir()), [settings_file])

            # Clearing again when rom_path is absent is a clean no-op
            launcher.clear_saved_rom_path(settings_file)
            self.assertEqual(launcher.load_settings(settings_file), {"custom_flag": "enabled"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unit tests for translator/prepare_rom.py custom-ROM isolation, bounds validation, and overlay 36."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

import translator.prepare_rom as prepare_rom_mod


def _arm_bl(from_addr: int, to_addr: int) -> int:
    delta = (to_addr - (from_addr + 8)) >> 2
    return 0xEB000000 | (delta & 0x00FFFFFF)


def _blz_compress_nops_64() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    """Return (compressed_blz, expected_64B_decompressed) for an active overlay."""
    prefix = struct.pack("<III", 0xE12FFF1E, 0xE1A00000, 0xE1A00000)  # 12 bytes
    nop = b"\x00\x00\xA0\xE1"
    expected = prefix + nop * 13  # 12 + 52 = 64 bytes

    # Backward stream ending at len(buf)-8:
    # - 4 compressed tokens (disp=4, len=12): each (lo=0x01, hi=0x90) -> 48 bytes
    # - 4 literal bytes (written in reverse at dst=63..60) -> 0xE1, 0xA0, 0x00, 0x00 in reverse = nop!
    # Wait: literals read backwards from src: dst=63 gets out[--src], so stream has [0x00, 0x00, 0xA0, 0xE1]
    stream = (b"\x01\x90" * 4) + nop + bytes([0x0F])
    comp_size = len(stream) + 8
    top_and_bottom = (8 << 24) | comp_size
    add_size = len(expected) - (len(prefix) + comp_size)
    compressed = prefix + stream + struct.pack("<II", top_and_bottom, add_size)
    return compressed, expected


def build_synthetic_nds_rom(
    *,
    num_overlays: int = 37,
    include_ov35_blz: bool = True,
    include_ov36: bool = True,
) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    """Construct a minimal valid NDS image with ARM9, ITCM autoload, ARM7, and overlays 0..36."""
    arm9_ram = 0x02000000
    arm9_entry = 0x02000800
    arm9_size = 0x1000
    arm9 = bytearray(arm9_size)

    # Place ModuleParams at +0x100 and NITRO_MAGIC at +0x11C
    mp_off = 0x100
    al_list = arm9_ram + 0x200
    al_list_end = al_list + 12
    al_start = arm9_ram + 0x240
    bss_start = arm9_ram + 0xC00
    bss_end = arm9_ram + 0xD00
    struct.pack_into(
        "<IIIIIII",
        arm9,
        mp_off,
        al_list,
        al_list_end,
        al_start,
        bss_start,
        bss_end,
        0,
        0x04020000,
    )
    arm9[mp_off + 28 : mp_off + 36] = prepare_rom_mod.NITRO_MAGIC

    # 1 ITCM autoload entry (0x01FF8000, size 0x40)
    struct.pack_into("<III", arm9, 0x200, 0x01FF8000, 0x40, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<I", arm9, 0x240, 0xE12FFF1E)  # BX lr in ITCM

    # Entry code at 0x02000800 calling helper at 0x02000814
    struct.pack_into("<II", arm9, 0x800, _arm_bl(0x02000800, 0x02000814), 0xE12FFF1E)
    struct.pack_into("<II", arm9, 0x814, 0xE92D4000, 0xE12FFF1E)  # STMFD sp!, {lr}; BX lr

    # ARM7 binary
    arm7_ram = 0x02380000
    arm7_entry = 0x02380200
    arm7_size = 0x400
    arm7 = bytearray(arm7_size)
    a7_al_list = arm7_ram + 0x1E8
    a7_al_list_end = a7_al_list + 12
    a7_al_start = arm7_ram + 0x300
    a7_bss_s = arm7_ram + 0x380
    struct.pack_into("<IIII", arm7, 0x1D0, a7_al_list, a7_al_list_end, a7_al_start, a7_bss_s)
    struct.pack_into("<III", arm7, 0x1E8, 0x037F8000, 0x20, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<I", arm7, 0x200, 0xE12FFF1E)
    struct.pack_into("<I", arm7, 0x300, 0xE12FFF1E)

    # Overlay payloads & FAT entries
    ov_payloads: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int, bytes]] = []
    ov35_expected = b""
    for oid in range(num_overlays):
        if oid == 35 and include_ov35_blz:
            comp, ov35_expected = _blz_compress_nops_64()
            ov_payloads.append((oid, 0x02300000, len(ov35_expected), 0, 0, 0x01000000, comp))
        elif oid == 36 and include_ov36:
            ov36 = bytearray(0x40)
            struct.pack_into("<I", ov36, 0x00, _arm_bl(0x023A0000, 0x023A0008))
            struct.pack_into("<I", ov36, 0x04, _arm_bl(0x023A0004, 0x02000820))  # cross-call into ARM9
            struct.pack_into("<I", ov36, 0x08, 0xE12FFF1E)
            struct.pack_into("<I", ov36, 0x10, 0xE12FFF1E)
            sinit_s = 0x023A0020
            sinit_e = 0x023A0024
            struct.pack_into("<I", ov36, 0x20, 0x023A0010)
            ov_payloads.append((oid, 0x023A0000, len(ov36), sinit_s, sinit_e, 0, bytes(ov36)))
        else:
            ov_payloads.append((oid, 0x022DC000, 0x10, 0, 0, 0, b"\x00" * 0x10))

    # Layout in ROM: header (0x200), arm9, ov9, arm7, fnt, fat, overlay payloads
    arm9_off = 0x200
    ov9_off = arm9_off + len(arm9)
    ov9_size = num_overlays * 32
    arm7_off = ov9_off + ov9_size
    fnt_off = arm7_off + len(arm7)
    fnt = b"\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00"  # empty root dir FNT
    fat_off = fnt_off + len(fnt)
    fat_size = num_overlays * 8
    data_off = fat_off + fat_size

    fat = bytearray(fat_size)
    ov9 = bytearray(ov9_size)
    payload_blob = bytearray()
    cur = data_off
    for idx, (oid, ram_addr, ram_size, sinit_s, sinit_e, comp_flag, blob) in enumerate(ov_payloads):
        start = cur
        end = start + len(blob)
        struct.pack_into("<II", fat, idx * 8, start, end)
        struct.pack_into(
            "<IIIIIIII",
            ov9,
            idx * 32,
            oid,
            ram_addr,
            ram_size,
            0,
            sinit_s,
            sinit_e,
            idx,
            comp_flag,
        )
        payload_blob.extend(blob)
        cur = end
        while len(payload_blob) % 4 != 0:
            payload_blob.append(0)
            cur += 1

    rom = bytearray(data_off + len(payload_blob))
    struct.pack_into("<IIII", rom, 0x20, arm9_off, arm9_entry, arm9_ram, len(arm9))
    struct.pack_into("<IIII", rom, 0x30, arm7_off, arm7_entry, arm7_ram, len(arm7))
    struct.pack_into("<IIII", rom, 0x40, fnt_off, len(fnt), fat_off, fat_size)
    struct.pack_into("<IIII", rom, 0x50, ov9_off, ov9_size, 0, 0)
    rom[arm9_off : arm9_off + len(arm9)] = arm9
    rom[ov9_off : ov9_off + ov9_size] = ov9
    rom[arm7_off : arm7_off + len(arm7)] = arm7
    rom[fnt_off : fnt_off + len(fnt)] = fnt
    rom[fat_off : fat_off + fat_size] = fat
    rom[data_off : data_off + len(payload_blob)] = payload_blob
    return bytes(rom), ov35_expected


def write_minimal_symbols(symbols_dir: Path) -> None:
    symbols_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (symbols_dir / "arm9.yml").write_text(
        "arm9:\n  address:\n    NA: 0x02000000\n  functions: []\n  data: []\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (symbols_dir / "arm7.yml").write_text(
        "arm7:\n  address:\n    NA: 0x02380000\n  functions: []\n  data: []\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


class TestPrepareRom(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_blz_decompression_roundtrip_helper(self) -> None:
        comp, expected = _blz_compress_nops_64()
        self.assertEqual(prepare_rom_mod.blz_decompress_backward(comp), expected)

    def test_custom_rom_overlay36_and_blz_overlay_without_yaml(self) -> None:
        rom_bytes, ov35_expected = build_synthetic_nds_rom()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = Path(td)
            rom_path = root / "custom_hack.nds"
            rom_path.write_bytes(rom_bytes)
            symbols_dir = root / "symbols"
            write_minimal_symbols(symbols_dir)
            out_dir = root / "extracted"

            sha1, region, banks = prepare_rom_mod.prepare_rom(
                rom_path,
                symbols_dir,
                out_dir,
                allow_custom_rom=True,
                forced_region="NA",
            )
            self.assertEqual(sha1, hashlib.sha1(rom_bytes).hexdigest())
            self.assertEqual(region, "NA")

            bank_map = {b.bank_name: b for b in banks}
            self.assertIn("sky_arm9_main_na", bank_map)
            self.assertIn("sky_arm7_main_na", bank_map)
            self.assertIn("sky_arm9_ov35_na", bank_map)
            self.assertIn("sky_arm9_ov36_na", bank_map)

            # Verify BLZ-compressed overlay 35 decompressed to expected bytes
            self.assertEqual(bank_map["sky_arm9_ov35_na"].bin_path.read_bytes(), ov35_expected)

            # Verify overlay 36 TOML seeded entry, sinit, and BL target without overlay36.yml
            ov36_toml = bank_map["sky_arm9_ov36_na"].toml_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIn("addr = 0x023A0000", ov36_toml)
            self.assertIn("addr = 0x023A0008", ov36_toml)
            self.assertIn("addr = 0x023A0010", ov36_toml)

            # Verify cross-overlay BL into ARM9 seeded 0x02000820
            arm9_toml = bank_map["sky_arm9_main_na"].toml_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIn("addr = 0x02000820", arm9_toml)

            manifest = json.loads((out_dir / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertTrue(manifest["is_custom_rom"])
            self.assertEqual(manifest["bank_count"], len(banks))

    def test_custom_rom_cache_isolation(self) -> None:
        repo = Path("/tmp/fake-repo")
        clean_sha1 = "5fa96ca8d8dd6405d6cd2bad73ed68bc73a9d152"
        custom_sha1 = "deadbeef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"

        c_out, c_gen = prepare_rom_mod.resolve_output_dirs(
            repo, clean_sha1, "NA", repo / "x", repo / "y", True, True
        )
        self.assertEqual(c_out, repo / "build" / "extracted_sky_us")
        self.assertEqual(c_gen, repo / "build" / "generated_sky_us")

        h_out, h_gen = prepare_rom_mod.resolve_output_dirs(
            repo, custom_sha1, "NA", repo / "x", repo / "y", True, True
        )
        self.assertEqual(h_out, repo / "build" / "extracted_sky_custom_us_deadbeef0123")
        self.assertEqual(h_gen, repo / "build" / "generated_sky_custom_us_deadbeef0123")
        self.assertNotEqual(h_out, c_out)
        self.assertNotEqual(h_gen, c_gen)

    def test_rejects_out_of_bounds_header_and_overlay_fat(self) -> None:
        rom_bytes, _ = build_synthetic_nds_rom(num_overlays=2, include_ov35_blz=False, include_ov36=False)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = Path(td)
            symbols_dir = root / "symbols"
            write_minimal_symbols(symbols_dir)

            tiny = root / "tiny.nds"
            tiny.write_bytes(b"\x00" * 0x100)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "too small"):
                prepare_rom_mod.prepare_rom(
                    tiny, symbols_dir, root / "out1", allow_custom_rom=True, forced_region="NA"
                )

            bad_sec = bytearray(rom_bytes)
            struct.pack_into("<II", bad_sec, 0x28, 0x02000000, len(bad_sec) + 0x100)
            bad_sec_path = root / "bad_sec.nds"
            bad_sec_path.write_bytes(bad_sec)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "ARM9 lies outside"):
                prepare_rom_mod.prepare_rom(
                    bad_sec_path, symbols_dir, root / "out2", allow_custom_rom=True, forced_region="NA"
                )

            bad_ov = bytearray(rom_bytes)
            ov9_off = struct.unpack_from("<I", bad_ov, 0x50)[0]
            struct.pack_into("<I", bad_ov, ov9_off + 24, 999)  # out-of-bounds FAT index
            bad_ov_path = root / "bad_ov.nds"
            bad_ov_path.write_bytes(bad_ov)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "out-of-bounds FAT index"):
                prepare_rom_mod.prepare_rom(
                    bad_ov_path, symbols_dir, root / "out3", allow_custom_rom=True, forced_region="NA"
                )

    unittest.main()
